traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Tropaeolaceae: leaves usually alternate, sometimes opposite; leaves simple or compound; compound leaves palmate; veins palmate; stipules present or absent; leaf rosettes none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup present; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary; flowers zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit schizocarp or drupe, rarely samara; stamens 8; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
